mapper.select: SELECT lock_id,sku_id,quantity,lock_no,sku_code,product_name,expires_at,order_id FROM bike_pi_revision_source WHERE pi_id=#{piId} ORDER BY lock_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM bike_pi_revision_source WHERE pi_id=#{piId} AND order_id IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_pi_revision_source SET order_id=#{orderId} WHERE pi_id=#{piId} AND lock_id=#{lockId} AND order_id IS NULL
UPDATE bike_order_reservation_item SET ordered_qty=#{quantity} WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND sku_id=#{skuId} AND closed_qty=0 AND shipped_qty<=#{quantity} AND #{quantity}>0
UPDATE bike_sales_order_item SET ordered_qty=#{quantity} WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND shipped_qty<=#{quantity} AND #{quantity}>0
UPDATE bike_order_reservation_item SET closed_qty=ordered_qty-shipped_qty WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND closed_qty=0

UPDATE bike_order_reservation SET reserved_qty=0,hold_mode='RELEASED',released_at=NOW(3) WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND scope_type='SKU' AND (hold_mode='PAID' OR (hold_mode='TIMED' AND expires_at>NOW(3)))
